name: Import
description: Import files into Ledger: from your browser (the Send to Ledger extension, included), from email (Ledger's Gmail or IMAP), from a network scanner, from a phone's camera, or uploaded. Check them, read them with AI (you approve what it found), and send them on to Auto sort, other modules or Ledger's CSV import.

fields.label: Delete sent and archived files after (days)
fields.help: 0 keeps them until you delete them. Files waiting in the inbox are never deleted automatically.

fields.label: Read email from

options.label: Gmail in the main books; nothing in other organizations

fields.help: Set per organization. Gmail needs Import allowed to read mail under Settings → Gmail. If the Auto sort module reads the same mailbox for bills, turn its email off (Settings → Auto sort) and send the files from here instead.

fields.label: Check email every (minutes)
fields.help: 0 turns scheduled checks off; Check email now on the Import page always works.

fields.label: Gmail search
fields.help: Optional, e.g. label:bills. Empty: any of the keywords below.

fields.label: Keywords
fields.default: invoice, bill, statement, amount due, balance due, payment due, due date, receipt, pre-authorized, autopay, facture
fields.help: Comma-separated. Only emails containing one of these are imported. Empty: every email the search finds.

fields.label: Save matching emails without attachments as .eml files
fields.help: For bills sent as the email itself; Auto sort reads .eml bills.

fields.label: IMAP server
fields.help: Only for IMAP, e.g. imap.fastmail.com, outlook.office365.com, imap.mail.me.com, or 127.0.0.1 for Proton Bridge.

fields.label: Network scanner
fields.help: Easiest from the Scan tab (Find scanners). Or its address, e.g. 192.168.1.40 or http://scanner.local/eSCL: a scanner or printer with AirScan / eSCL on your local network.
